summary: Example capture used only to exercise the candidate validator.

candidates.statement: The capture gate refuses a candidate whose rationale only repeats its statement.
candidates.rationale: A Record without a cause cannot tell a future agent whether the rule still applies, so storing it would mislead every later change.

candidates.statement: Candidate bindings accept a path::symbol string or a structured path and symbol object.
candidates.rationale: Agents emit both shapes, and accepting both avoids discarding real knowledge because of formatting.
